description: UI, routing, views, and app bootstrap: js/router.js (hash routing), js/ui.js (DOM helpers + the reusable 3-dots action-sheet, autocomplete, qty editor), the five views js/views/{spesa,dispensa,desideri,prodotti,auth}.js, and js/app.js (bootstrap wiring SW auto-update, router, header, auth-state-driven sync). Implements orchestrator decision D3 ('Segna come comprato' behavior) in the Spesa view and the auth-view contract (design §13). Depends on FEAT-002 (views call store.js, auth.js calls supabase.js, app.js calls sync.js) and on FEAT-001's index.html/shell. This completes the runnable app.
steps: Create js/router.js (design §10): hash routes '#/spesa' (default), '#/dispensa', '#/desideri', '#/prodotti'. startRouter(routes,{mount}) resolves the current hash (fallback '#/spesa'), on hashchange + initial load calls the previous view's destroy() (unregisters its onChange listener), clears the mount (#view), then calls the new view's render(container) which returns {destroy}. navigate(path) sets location.hash. Each view exports render(container):{destroy}.

Create js/ui.js (design §9): el(tag,props,children) hyperscript helper; toast(message,type='info',ms=2500) bottom auto-dismiss toast; openModal({title,content,actions}) returning {close()}; openSheet({title,items}) returning a Promise that resolves to the tapped item's `value` or null on dismiss (backdrop/Esc/back) — items carry {label,icon,value,danger}, NO onSelect callback (single promise mechanism); this openSheet IS the reusable 3-dots kebab/action-sheet. openChoice(title,options) and confirmSheet(message,{okLabel,danger}) built on openSheet (e.g. ['Frigo','Dispensa']). attachAutocomplete(inputEl,{onPick,onConfirmNew}) returning a detach fn (suggestion <ul> populated on input, debounced 150ms, via store.suggestProducts; tap/Enter selects a product via onPick or confirms new text via onConfirmNew). qtyEditor({value,unit}) returning {element, read():{qtyValue,qtyUnit}} (numeric field accepting Italian comma via units.parseDecimal + a unit <select> of UNITS). All strings Italian. Also expose the sync:status chip updater path app.js registers.

Create js/views/spesa.js (design §7/§8, D3): render lists live list voices (not-bought first, bought struck-through and sorted to the BOTTOM). Add in 3 ways, ALL via store.ensureListRef: (a) typed input + attachAutocomplete (onConfirmNew → getOrCreateProduct → ensureListRef, then if the qtyEditor is non-empty apply updateListItem(ref.id,{qtyValue,qtyUnit})); (b) Ricorrenti quick-pick openSheet of recurring products → ensureListRef (unspecified qty); (c) Desideri quick-pick openSheet of current wishlist products → ensureListRef (unspecified qty, wishlist entry left in place). Per-row compact qtyEditor → updateListItem on commit. Kebab (openSheet) per row: 'Segna come comprato' → markBought(id,true) (D3: item stays, struck-through, moves to bottom; a bought row's kebab instead offers 'Segna come da comprare' → markBought(id,false)); 'Scarta' → discardListItem; 'Aggiungi alla dispensa' → openChoice('Frigo o Dispensa?',['Frigo','Dispensa']) → listItemToPantry(id,location) and toast from the structured result ('Unità diverse: tengo le voci separate' when merged===false && items.length===2). On mount register db.onChange re-reading the list store (tolerate type:'tx', id undefined); unregister in destroy. Orphaned-ref rule: a row whose getProduct(productId) is undefined renders '(prodotto eliminato)' greyed, keeps its qty visible, and enables only the destructive kebab action ('Scarta'); never throw.

Create js/views/dispensa.js (design §8): filter tabs 'Frigo' | 'Dispensa' (default 'Frigo', optional 'Tutti'). Direct add: typed input + attachAutocomplete + frigo/dispensa choice → mergePantryQuantity (toast the structured result). Per-item: qtyEditor → updatePantryItem; expiry <input type=date> (stores 'YYYY-MM-DD' or null) → updatePantryItem. Expiry highlight via store.daysUntil(expiry): <0 scaduto (red), 0..3 in scadenza (amber), >3 or null neutral — NO lexical string arithmetic. Kebab (openSheet): 'Aggiungi alla spesa' → ensureListRef; 'Aggiungi ai desideri' → ensureWishlistRef; 'Rimuovi' → removePantryItem. db.onChange on pantry store on mount, unregister in destroy. Same orphaned-ref placeholder rule (destructive 'Rimuovi' only when product undefined).

Create js/views/desideri.js (design §8): typed input + attachAutocomplete → getOrCreateProduct → ensureWishlistRef (dedupes one live wishlist entry per product). Kebab (openSheet): 'Aggiungi alla spesa' → ensureListRef; 'Aggiungi alla dispensa' → openChoice('Frigo o Dispensa?') → mergePantryQuantity(location,productId,null,null). db.onChange on wishlist store; destroy unregisters. Orphaned-ref placeholder rule (destructive remove only).

Create js/views/prodotti.js (design §8, D2): list all live products; search box filtering by nameLower.includes + a 'solo ricorrenti' toggle. Kebab (openSheet) per product: 'Elimina' → confirmSheet('Elimina «name» e le sue voci?',{danger:true}) → deleteProductCascade(id) (D2); 'Aggiungi alla spesa' → ensureListRef; 'Aggiungi ai desideri' → ensureWishlistRef; 'Aggiungi alla dispensa' → openChoice(frigo/dispensa) → mergePantryQuantity(location,id,null,null); 'Ricorrenti' toggle → toggleRecurring(id). db.onChange on products store; destroy unregisters.

Create js/views/auth.js (design §13): a render usable inside a modal/sheet using ONLY supabase.js auth helpers. Sign in: on error toast the mapped Italian message (invalid credentials → 'Email o password non corretti'; email not confirmed → 'Conferma prima la tua email per accedere'; else 'Accesso non riuscito, riprova'; console.warn raw) and STAY on the panel; on success close the panel. Sign up: on error toast mapped message (already-registered → 'Email già registrata, prova ad accedere'; weak/invalid → specific or 'Registrazione non riuscita, riprova') and stay; on success branch on data.session — non-null → close (signed-in), null → persistent info 'Registrazione effettuata: conferma l'email per accedere' and keep the panel, app stays usable anonymously at ZERO network. The view NEVER calls fullSync (app.js SIGNED_IN handler is the sole sync driver).

Create js/app.js (design §15): 1) await openDB() guarded — on failure show a blocking 'IndexedDB non disponibile' message and stop. 2) register navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js'); wire SKIP_WAITING auto-update (post {type:'SKIP_WAITING'} to a waiting worker; on controllerchange reload once). 3) startRouter with the four section render fns, default '#/spesa'. 4) wire header: account chip (session email or 'Accedi' opening the auth modal via views/auth.js), 'Sincronizza' button → fullSync(). 5) onAuthStateChange((event,session)=>{update chip; on SIGNED_IN/TOKEN_REFRESHED with session: prev=getMeta('lastSyncUser'); if prev non-null && prev!==session.user.id run account-switch procedure (sync.js) THEN fullSync(); else setMeta('lastSyncUser',session.user.id) then fullSync() — this handler is the SOLE fullSync driver for login; on SIGNED_OUT emit sync:status 'offline', keep local data/cursors, leave lastSyncUser}. 6) sync.init(); register a sync:status callback that updates the status chip. All strings Italian.
acceptance_criteria: node --check passes for js/router.js, js/ui.js, and all five js/views/*.js and js/app.js.

All three Spesa add paths go through store.ensureListRef (no direct addListItem from the view); bought items render struck-through and sorted to the bottom and their kebab still offers Scarta + Aggiungi alla dispensa + toggle back (D3).

ui.openSheet resolves to the tapped item's value or null on dismiss with no onSelect field; qtyEditor.read() returns {qtyValue,qtyUnit} parsed via units.parseDecimal; attachAutocomplete uses store.suggestProducts debounced.

Every reference view (spesa/dispensa/desideri) renders '(prodotto eliminato)' and enables only the destructive kebab action when getProduct returns undefined, and never throws; dispensa expiry classification uses store.daysUntil, not string arithmetic.

Prodotti 'Elimina' goes through confirmSheet then deleteProductCascade (D2); auth.js never calls fullSync and shows the persistent confirm-email message on data.session===null; app.js drives fullSync only from the auth-state handler and the manual button and runs account-switch before fullSync when the user id changes.
No occurrence of workouts|exercises|weight_log anywhere in the created files.
verification: Grep js/ for workouts|exercises|weight_log and confirm zero matches

Code-inspect per acceptance criteria: Spesa 3-paths-via-ensureListRef + bought-to-bottom (D3), openSheet promise contract, orphaned-ref placeholder in all three reference views, dispensa daysUntil usage, Prodotti confirm+cascade (D2), auth.js no-fullSync + confirm-email branch, app.js sole-fullSync-driver + account-switch ordering + openDB guard + SKIP_WAITING wiring
findings:
All eight files created under js/ and js/views/ and verified: node --check passes for router.js, ui.js, spesa.js, dispensa.js, desideri.js, prodotti.js, auth.js, app.js. Grep js/ for workouts|exercises|weight_log => ZERO matches. The runnable app is complete (slots into FEAT-001 shell + FEAT-002 core).

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES / CONTRACTS HONORED:

router.js (§10): startRouter(routes,{mount}) + navigate(path). routes keyed by path ('/spesa' default, '/dispensa','/desideri','/prodotti'). On hashchange+initial load: calls prev view destroy(), clears #view (textContent=''), calls new render(container)->{destroy}, toggles .active on .nav-btn[data-route]. Empty hash normalized to '#/spesa' via history.replaceState. navigate() re-renders directly when hash is unchanged (so a nav tap on the current section still works). Each view exports render(container):{destroy}.

ui.js (§9): el(tag,props,children) hyperscript (supports class/className, dataset, style obj, on* listeners, property-or-attribute fallback). toast(message,type,ms) into a lazily-created .toast-wrap (auto-dismiss, returns {close}). openModal({title,content,actions}) returns {close, element} — note it exposes `element` (the .modal node) so callers can append content after construction (app.js auth modal uses this). openSheet({title,items}) is the SINGLE reusable 3-dots sheet: returns a Promise resolving the tapped item.value or null on dismiss (backdrop/Esc/popstate) — items carry {label,icon,value,danger}, NO onSelect. openChoice(title,options[])->Promise<label|null>. confirmSheet(message,{okLabel,danger})->Promise<bool> built on openSheet (ok/cancel items). attachAutocomplete(inputEl,{onPick,onConfirmNew})->detach(): wraps input in .autocomplete, debounced 150ms via store.suggestProducts, keyboard (ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Esc) + tap; Enter with no active suggestion -> onConfirmNew(trimmed text). qtyEditor({value,unit})->{element, read()} ; read() returns {qtyValue:null,qtyUnit:null} for empty/invalid, else {qtyValue:parseDecimal(text), qtyUnit:<select>}.

spesa.js (§7/§8, D3): all three add paths go through store.ensureListRef (typed via getOrCreateProduct->ensureListRef then updateListItem when qty non-empty; Ricorrenti openSheet of recurring products -> ensureListRef; Desideri openSheet of wishlist products -> ensureListRef, wishlist left in place). No direct addListItem anywhere in views (verified by grep). D3: markBought(id,true) keeps the row, struck-through (.row.bought), sorted to the BOTTOM (sort: bought last, then createdAt asc); a bought row's kebab offers 'Segna come da comprare' (markBought false) + 'Scarta' + 'Aggiungi alla dispensa'. 'Aggiungi alla dispensa' -> openChoice('Frigo o Dispensa?',['Frigo','Dispensa']) -> listItemToPantry(id,location); toast 'Unità diverse: tengo le voci separate' when merged===false && items.length===2. Per-row qtyEditor commits via updateListItem. db.onChange re-reads on store 'list' or 'products' (tolerates type:'tx', id undefined). Orphaned-ref: getProduct undefined -> '(prodotto eliminato)' greyed title (.orphaned), qty kept visible, kebab filtered to only 'Scarta'; never throws.

dispensa.js (§8): tabs Frigo(default)/Dispensa/Tutti. Direct add typed+autocomplete -> openChoice frigo/dispensa -> mergePantryQuantity (toast from structured result). Per-item qtyEditor->updatePantryItem; <input type=date>->updatePantryItem (value or null). Expiry classification via store.daysUntil only (NO string arithmetic): <0 'Scaduto' .scaduto, 0..3 'Scade oggi/tra N g' .in-scadenza, else neutral; expiry==null -> no chip. Kebab: 'Aggiungi alla spesa'->ensureListRef; 'Aggiungi ai desideri'->ensureWishlistRef; 'Rimuovi'->removePantryItem. Orphaned-ref -> only 'Rimuovi'. db.onChange on 'pantry'|'products'.

desideri.js (§8): typed+autocomplete -> getOrCreateProduct -> ensureWishlistRef (dedup). Kebab: 'Aggiungi alla spesa'->ensureListRef; 'Aggiungi alla dispensa'->openChoice->mergePantryQuantity(location,productId,null,null); 'Rimuovi'->removeWishlistItem. Orphaned-ref -> only 'Rimuovi'. db.onChange on 'wishlist'|'products'.

prodotti.js (§8, D2): lists live products, search filter via normalizeName+nameLower.includes, 'Solo ricorrenti' checkbox. Kebab: 'Aggiungi alla spesa'/'Aggiungi ai desideri'/'Aggiungi alla dispensa'(openChoice->mergePantryQuantity(,,null,null))/'Ricorrenti' toggle(toggleRecurring)/'Elimina'. 'Elimina' -> confirmSheet('Elimina «name» e le sue voci?',{danger:true}) -> deleteProductCascade (D2). db.onChange on 'products'.

auth.js (§13): render({close}) returns the panel element (hosted in app.js modal). Uses ONLY signIn/signUp from supabase.js. NEVER calls fullSync (verified: fullSync appears only in comments). Error mapping to Italian (invalid creds -> 'Email o password non corretti'; not confirmed -> 'Conferma prima la tua email per accedere'; else 'Accesso non riuscito, riprova'; signup already-registered -> 'Email già registrata, prova ad accedere'; weak pw / bad email specific else 'Registrazione non riuscita, riprova'); raw error console.warn'd; stays on panel on error. signIn success -> close(). signUp success branches on data.session: non-null -> close (signed-in); null -> persistent info 'Registrazione effettuata: conferma l'email per accedere', panel stays, zero network.

app.js (§15): (1) await openDB() guarded -> on failure a blocking 'IndexedDB non disponibile...' message in #view and return. (2) SW register('./sw.js') + SKIP_WAITING: posts to reg.waiting on register and on updatefound->installed-with-controller; reloads once on controllerchange (guarded flag). (3) startRouter with the four render fns, default '#/spesa'. (4) header: #sync-btn -> sync.fullSync(); #sync-chip shows session email or 'Accedi' and opens the auth modal (openModal + renderAuth({close})). (5) onAuthStateChange: updates chip; on SIGNED_IN/TOKEN_REFRESHED with session -> prev=getMeta('lastSyncUser'); if prev!=null && prev!==id -> sync.switchAccount(id) (clears domain stores + resets cursors + sets lastSyncUser + fullSync, in that order) ELSE setMeta('lastSyncUser',id)+fullSync() — the SOLE login fullSync driver; on SIGNED_OUT -> status 'offline', local data/cursors/lastSyncUser untouched. (6) sync.onStatus(renderStatus) toggles #sync-chip data-state ok/error (removes attr otherwise, matching FEAT-001 styles.css chip states); sync.init().

INTEGRATION NOTE: no changes made to styles.css. The views reuse the component classes FEAT-001 shipped (.card/.row/.row-main/.row-title/.row-sub/.row.bought/.kebab-btn/.expiry.*/.qty-editor/.autocomplete*/.sheet*/.modal*/.toast*/.btn*/.input/.select/.empty). A few view-only wrapper classes used for layout are NOT yet in styles.css (.add-bar/.add-row/.quick-picks/.tabs/.tab/.tab.active/.toggle-label/.row-qty-edit/.row-expiry-edit/.qty-commit/.row-title.orphaned/.auth-view/.auth-actions/.auth-info); they degrade gracefully (unstyled but fully functional). If polish is wanted, add these to styles.css in a follow-up — out of FEAT-003's file scope (JS only).
